market_notes: Japanese readers include tourists and many 駐在員 and 留学生. Japan's MOFA and embassy state that a Japanese-issued international permit is not valid in Vietnam, so licence conversion (切り替え) and insurance (海外旅行保険, クレジットカード付帯保険) are distinct, high-stakes intents. Queries are space-separated noun chains; overlap scoring uses character bigrams.
